integrity: The exact 99-tetrahedron complex is reconstructed independently. Smith invariants 1^97,2 are certified using unimodular operations, two integral cocycles give the free coordinates, a mod-two cocycle detects the unique torsion kernel, and all graph triangles are exhausted.
scientific_limitations: Specific to the labelled sixteen-vertex triangulation of Klein bottle x S1 and to simple cycles measured by edge length. The displayed coordinates depend on a certified basis, while the seven-class structure and multiplicities up to the stated pairing are intrinsic to the labelled complex.
title: Seven homology classes exhaust the triangular systoles of a sixteen-vertex Klein-bottle product
